findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body: When the user and document belong to different tenants, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` unconditionally. This removes the function’s tenant-isolation check and permits cross-tenant document reads wherever this exported authorization helper is used.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now returns `true` when `userTenant !== documentTenant`, allowing any tenant to read another tenant’s documents wherever this authorization function is enforced.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body:
Returning `true` unconditionally authorizes document access when `userTenant !== documentTenant`, allowing any tenant to read another tenant’s documents wherever this authorization helper is enforced.
